title: No regression coverage for the by-church patristic quotes route
reasoning: The route is exposed as a network-facing API endpoint with user-controlled church_id path input, but the included linked tests cover Armenian text, Bible API, devotionals, email tasks/templates, fast views, and feast admin icon actions. None exercise this route, its URL resolution, status behavior for valid/invalid church IDs, church scoping, or serialized response shape, so regressions in this endpoint could ship unnoticed.
recommendation: Add focused API tests for /api/patristic-quotes/by-church/<church_id>/ covering a church with quotes, an empty church, nonexistent church_id behavior, and response serialization/order expectations.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included test files do not reference PatristicQuotesByChurchView or the patristic-quotes/by-church URL; they exercise adjacent or unrelated endpoints and helpers.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a patristic quote API test module that seeds two churches and quotes, calls /api/patristic-quotes/by-church/<church_id>/, and asserts only that church's quotes are returned with the expected status and payload shape.
minimumFixScope: Add endpoint-level tests for the declared route and any minimal fixture setup required for patristic quote data.
